title: Albany NanoTech Pioneers 193nm Immersion Lithography R&D with ASML, IBM, TEL, AMD and Infineon

passages.locator: Opening paragraph and paragraph beginning Under the program
passages.note: Albany NanoTech reports that installation and qualification for 300 mm wafers were already under way. It identifies the TWINSCAN AT:1150i and Tokyo Electron CLEAN TRACK LITHIUS as the scanner and the coater/developer used in the research cluster.
